label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value q = "UPDATE accounts SET note='" + param + "' WHERE id=1" where param is derived from request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest"). Untrusted input is concatenated directly into the SQL string without sanitization or parameterization. Although execution occurs outside this method, the construction of the dynamic SQL stores the vulnerable payload, representing a confirmed injection vector.

evidence.note: User input param extracted and concatenated directly into SQL string q without sanitization
